scope: Current linked audiovisual licence follow-up for the exact Dutch House identity; no fresh playback or programme-guide certification.
method: Read the current Dutch disclaimer, official audiovisual-supply page and all four pages of the linked licence in text and rendered form. The English generic notice differs; the Dutch disclaimer expressly refers audiovisual users to the specific licence. No login, acceptance control, media download or outreach was performed.

metadata.exact_scope: House of Representatives; does not apply to the separate Eerste Kamer.

confirmed: The current Dutch disclaimer directs audiovisual use to a specific four-page licence dated 1 May 2019, also linked by the official media-supply page.

The supply page identifies Debat Direct for public plenary and committee proceedings and describes media download/embed access. High-quality media accounts have a separate eligibility route; no account was requested.

linking.finding: Do not convert provisions about linked external sites into an inbound-link prohibition or licence.

embedding.finding: The supply page expressly offers journalistic fragment embedding; arbitrary whole-site framing is not established.

direct_playback.finding: The licence permits qualifying audiovisual use on internet/TV/other media; it does not verify the current catalogued HLS routes.

rebroadcast.finding: The media-use grant is subject to the common conditions below; no unrestricted relay licence is claimed.

copying_recording.finding: Raw acquired material may not be archived and must be destroyed within one month, except qualifying works incorporating it.

audiovisual_reuse.finding: Covered plenary/committee material may be excerpted or incorporated with context intact; the licence is nontransferable.

programme_data.finding: The Dutch disclaimer permits text reuse with source credit unless otherwise specified; no timed guide or separate database licence is validated.

common_av_conditions.summary: Media and other users receive conditional permission; use itself counts as acceptance. Purposes are journalism, expression, education or research. Commercial/advertising, entertainment, sponsor/member recruitment, sale/rental and prohibited contexts are excluded. Visible source credit, copyright, licence reference and disclosure of edits are required; context must remain faithful. Third-party rights remain separate. Terms may change or permission be reasonably withdrawn; users must support prompt removal.

catalogue_updates.scope: Plenary meeting material only; retain the recorded technical history rather than claiming a new playback test.
Committee meeting material only; application to other event types is not presumed.
Occasional-event content needs a match to the licence's plenary/committee scope.
catalogue_updates.playback_policy_note: Existing native playback remains under the project opt-out policy with pending permission; no claim is made that non-meeting events are covered by this licence.

unresolved: Current decoded playback, audio, captions and every room remain untested in this follow-up.
A scheduled event, a permitted purpose and compliance with every required notice must be assessed individually; the aggregate permission label is not blanket clearance.
Non-meeting events, programme-to-room mapping, freshness, timezone conversion and XMLTV parser coverage remain open.

sources.observation: Current Dutch copyright sections distinguish text, photographs and audiovisual material; the latter links the specific licence.
Designates Debat Direct, plenary and committee material, journalistic fragment download/embed tools, high-quality account eligibility and the licence.
All four pages text-read and visually inspected. Current linked version bears 1 May 2019; no later version was inferred from retrieval date.
